## Decisions
- Current LM Studio models and historical run models are different sources of truth -> LM Studio `/v1/models` shows current inventory, while `runs/` metadata shows old/completed run models.
- Run filters derive from filesystem runs -> filters should not lose old models just because LM Studio no longer lists them.
- Detail view prioritizes the artifact -> completed run value is the saved visual output, not metadata or prompt text.
- Optional files are reflected from reality -> raw response, prompt, preview, and HTML actions only appear when `listRunMetadata()` hydrates them as present.
- Generated run artifacts are not app code -> do not edit files under `runs/` to fix viewer UX.
